test.title: Connection test
test.ipHint: Add this IP to the account's IP whitelist on the WeChat console and test again

codes.B6001: WeChat could not be reached or its answer could not be read: check that this server can reach api.weixin.qq.com, then try again later
codes.B6002: WeChat refused the request: check the account's status and settings, then try again
codes.B6003: The account may not call this API: unverified and sandbox accounts often lack it
codes.B6004: This server's IP is not on the account's IP whitelist
codes.B6005: Today's call quota of this API is used up: try tomorrow, or reset it under "API quota"
codes.B6006: WeChat does not accept the AppID or AppSecret: check them and enter the AppSecret again under "Edit" (a wrong AppID needs a new account)
